Composite discoloration indicator (ICD) for a monitoring zone

Source: R/icd_pipeline.R
run_icd_decoloration.Rd

Runs the ICD chain of the method note "Suivi de la decoloration anormale du feuillage" (v2, 2026-10-29, sections 3 to 8) on one monitoring zone, as FAST, FORDEAD and RECONFORT do (spec 071):

  1. **Ingest** (`ingest = TRUE`): Sentinel-2 L2A bands B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B08, B8A, B11, B12 and the SCL layer, into the shared COG cache (`ingest_s2_raw_bands_to_cache()`, events `s2:*`).

  2. **Indices** per scene at 20 m ([icd_indices()]), after the L2A offset correction and the SCL mask (classes 0, 1, 3, 8, 9, 10, 11).

  3. **Monthly composite**, April to October, since 2017: the median of the valid images of the month; a month without valid image stays empty. A composite is written atomically; an unreadable one is deleted and rebuilt at the next run. With `mois_en_cours = "garder"` the month under way is left as it is until it has ended for 5 days.

  4. **Standardised anomaly** `z = (x - median of the other years) / max(1.4826 MAD, floor)`, same pixel, same month; at least 4 reference years, otherwise `NA`. Floors: 0.01 (GRVI, CRre, NDVI), 0.05 (CIre), 0.02 (CRSWIR). A pixel is removed from its clear-cut month onward when `sufosat_dates` is given.

  5. **ICD** `w1 z(GRVI) + w2 z(CIre) - w3 z(CRSWIR) - w4 z(CRre) + w5 z(NDVI)` on the sensitive months of the species group, with the weights `poids`.

  6. **Class and level** of each year: Alert (ICD < -2 for at least 2 consecutive valid months, alert date = first month), Watch (ICD < -1.5 once), Normal; levels 0 to 4 (3 = alert with minimum ICD < -3, 4 = alert this year and over the whole previous season). A second set, "to date", reads every year on the months already available this year.

Only pixels of the four pure stands (BD Foret V2, TFV FF1G01-01, FF1-09-09, FF2G61-61, FF2-64-64; 10 m edge removed) get an ICD; the others have none (no value is invented). Only the weights are parameters; thresholds, persistence and months are those of the note.

Usage

run_icd_decoloration(
  con = NULL,
  zone_id,
  cache_dir,
  result_dir = NULL,
  poids = icd_poids_defaut(),
  bdforet = NULL,
  sufosat_dates = NULL,
  sufosat_proba = NULL,
  annees_reference = NULL,
  buffer_interieur = 10,
  start_year = .ICD_ANNEE_DEBUT,
  end_year = NULL,
  ingest = TRUE,
  max_cloud = .ICD_NUAGES_MAX,
  mois_en_cours = c("garder", "refaire"),
  apply_zone_mask = TRUE,
  write_alerts = TRUE,
  progress_callback = NULL,
  cancel_path = NULL,
  today = Sys.Date(),
  aoi = NULL,
  source_s2 = NULL
)

Arguments

con

A `DBIConnection` (zone geometry, alerts), or `NULL` when `aoi` is given.

zone_id

Integer. Monitoring zone.

cache_dir

Character. Root of the Sentinel-2 COG cache.

result_dir

Character. Root of the ICD results; default `<dirname(cache_dir)>/icd`.

poids

Weights table, see [icd_poids_defaut()] and [icd_poids_valider()]; a row whose sum is not 1 is rescaled to 1 and the run says so.

bdforet

BD Foret V2 polygons (`sf` with a `code_tfv` column) or a `SpatRaster` already coded 1..4 (`chene`, `hetre`, `sapin_epicea`, `douglas`). Required: without species there is no ICD.

sufosat_dates, sufosat_proba

Optional `SpatRaster`s of SUFOSAT clear-cut dates (`YYDDD`) and probability (percent, kept when >= 90). Without them clear-cuts are not removed, and the result says so.

annees_reference

Optional integer vector of healthy years used as reference; default: all other years.

buffer_interieur

Edge removed from the pure stands, in metres.

start_year, end_year

First and last year; `end_year` defaults to the year of `today`.

ingest

Logical. Fetch the bands first (needs `con` and the network).

max_cloud

Scene cloud cover ceiling for the STAC search (percent).

mois_en_cours

`"garder"` (default) or `"refaire"`.

apply_zone_mask

Logical. Mask pixels outside the UGF zone.

write_alerts

Logical. Write the yearly alerts of the last year in the `alert` table (`alert_type = "icd_decoloration"`) when `con` is a database connection.

progress_callback

Optional `function(payload)`.

cancel_path

Optional cancellation flag file.

today

Date; for tests.

aoi

Optional `sf` zone polygon, instead of reading it from `con`.

source_s2

Sentinel-2 reflectance source (mission 096): `NULL` (default: nothing changes, same search, same cache, same outputs as before), `"theia"` (MAJA, THEIA STAC catalogue, cache `<cache_dir>_theia`) or `"sen2cor"` (CDSE then Planetary Computer, without the MUSCATE fallback). This method is calibrated on Sen2Cor: `"theia"` warns (class `nemeton_s2_source_non_calee`) and records `calee_sur` and `mention_source`. THEIA unavailable switches the WHOLE series to Sen2Cor (class `nemeton_s2_repli_sen2cor`); a 401/403 or missing keys is an error. The effective source is written in the outputs as `source_s2` only when this argument is given. THEIA results go to `<result_dir>_theia`. See [s2_source_resoudre()].

Value

A list with `status` (`"success"`, `"cancelled"`, `"error"`), `zone_dir`, `annees`, `poids` (the weights actually used, with the attributes of [icd_poids_valider()]), `coupes_retirees` (logical), `n_pixels_zone`, `n_pixels_icd`, `n_pixels_sans_icd`, `alertes` (rows inserted) and `message`.

Details

Outputs are rasters under `<result_dir>/zone_<id>/`: `composites/`, `z/`, `icd/` (one file per year and month), `annuel/` and `annuel_a_date/` (layers `classe`, `niveau`, `icd_min`, `mois_alerte`, `n_mois_valides`), `essence.tif` and `meta.json`. They are read back with [read_icd_raster()] and [read_icd_pixel_series()].

Progress events (`progress_callback`, same channel as `s2:*`): `icd:start`, `icd:composite` (`completed`, `total`), `icd:anomalies`, `icd:annuel`, `icd:alertes`, then exactly one terminal event: `icd:complete`, `icd:cancelled` or `icd:error`. Cancellation is cooperative: the `cancel_path` flag file is polled before each scene and each month; what is already on disk stays valid.

See also

[read_icd_raster()], [read_icd_pixel_series()], [comparer_fast_icd()], [icd_poids_defaut()].
